_comment: All bytes are 0x-hex, lower case; uint values are JSON numbers. Generated by clients/clientkeys/scripts/pqchat-vectors.mjs (src/pqchat.js); never edit by hand. Random inputs are fixed: rnd(name, n) = the first n bytes of keccak256("scaas/pqchat/vectors/<name>/0") ‖ keccak256("scaas/pqchat/vectors/<name>/1") ‖ …; the labels are in the generator. Sources: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-25-ua7-pq-e2e-sessions.md (§4, §6, §7, §10), docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-07-pqchat-public-topics.md (§2), plan block "Group 3c" (3C-D3, 3C-D5, 3C-D9). UNAUDITED. The signed contact card (UA-7 spec §14 O7, its Change of 2026-11-05; CLI-PQC-05): PqChatCard(bytes32 ua, uint64 kemVersion, string matrixId), signed off chain and exchanged out of band, in records.json's DS_C under its PURPOSE_PQCHAT by its signers (kind 0x0131, real ML-DSA-65 signatures, UASig keyData and members empty); matrixId empty = no Matrix id. A card counts for a UA when its ua is that UA, its matrixId is well formed and its uaSig is that UA's portable signature of it. refused: a card each check refuses (error names the check: signature or ua), with its twin (one change back) that passes; key = the signer whose public key verifies, ua = the UA the card is checked for. matrixIdAccepted / matrixIdRefused: the Matrix id rule (empty, or @localpart:server in at most 255 bytes of 0x21-0x7e, a non-empty localpart without ':', a non-empty server name), each refusal with its accepted twin.
